name: Four Seasons Hotel Baku
positioning: Beaux-Arts-style hotel on the Caspian Sea waterfront in Baku, a five-minute walk from the UNESCO-listed Old City
best_for: Travelers who want a Caspian Sea waterfront base next to the Old City
Guests who want an on-site spa with a hammam and an indoor pool

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Baku opened in September 2012.
The hotel has 171 rooms and suites.
The hotel is a new building in the French Beaux-Arts style.
The hotel is at 1 Neftchilar Avenue, on the Caspian Sea waterfront.
Icheri Sheher, Baku's UNESCO-listed Old City, is a five-minute walk from the hotel.
Zafferano is the hotel's Italian restaurant.
Bentley's is a whisky and cigars lounge at the hotel.
Piazza is a lounge just off the lobby that serves afternoon tea.
Jaleh Spa is on the 9th floor.
The indoor pool is on the 7th floor.
The hotel offers complimentary premium Wi-Fi.
Four Seasons Hotel Baku is the only Forbes 5-Star hotel in Azerbaijan.

highlights.text: In the Deluxe Caspian Sea-View Room, arched French doors open to a private balcony.
The Panoramic View Two-Bedroom Suites are in the building's corner turrets.
The hotel has a Turkish-style hammam.
The VIP Couples' Spa Suite overlooks the Caspian Sea.
The hotel offers a Guided Baku Caviar Tasting Experience.
Condé Nast Traveler describes a pool housed under a glass-roofed ceiling.

considerations.text: The drive from Heydar Aliyev International Airport to the hotel takes 30 to 40 minutes.
Outdoor seating for Zafferano is available in the summer months only, on the Eyvan Terrace.
Most visitors need an electronic visa for Azerbaijan, obtained by online application ahead of travel.
The hotel has one on-site restaurant and two lounges.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
